ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.3-C4O1 Good-Run Baseline
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Performance branch based on the selected D.2.3 good run. Retains its productive T34-B, T34-D.1.3, S4, S5.1, DoBill, CommonSense, T21, T22, T28 and T32 paths. C.4 classification is restricted to the measured high-yield HaulCorpses invariant type-negative kernel; Refuel/Fire shadow census and the zero-yield asset cleanup coalescer are retired.
